Truthful, but he transmitted mostly from the weak and unknown, and was weakened for that reason.
حتى نسبه بن نمير إلى الكذب
Ibn Numayr even attributed lying to him.

t6481.bio: Ibn Ḥajar records Mujāhid ibn Jabr, Abū al-Ḥajjāj al-Makhzūmī their client, the Meccan, trustworthy, an authority in tafsīr and knowledge, of the third generation, died in 101–104 at age eighty-three.
as: ثقة إمام في التفسير وفي العلم
Trustworthy, an authority in tafsīr and in knowledge.
Abū Zurʿah al-Rāzī, quoted by al-Mizzī
Abū Ḥātim al-Rāzī, quoted by al-Mizzī
روى عن عائشة مرسلا، ولم يسمع منها
He transmitted from ʿĀʾishah in mursal form and did not hear from her.
Yaḥyā ibn Maʿīn, quoted by al-Mizzī
Mujāhid did not hear from ʿĀʾishah.
كان أعلمهم بالتفسير مجاهد، وبالحج عطاء.
Mujāhid knew Qur’an commentary best, while ʿAṭāʾ knew pilgrimage best.
مرسلات مجاهد أحب إلي من مرسلات عطاء بكثير.
I much prefer Mujāhid’s mursal reports to ʿAṭāʾ’s.
Yaḥyā ibn Maʿīn, quoted by al-Mizzī
مراسيل مجاهد، عطاء كان يحمل عن كل ضرب.
I prefer Mujāhid’s mursal reports. ʿAṭāʾ used to take from every sort of transmitter.
سلمة بن كهيل, quoted by al-Mizzī
ما رأيت أحدا أراد بهذا العلم وجه الله إلا عطاء، وطاووس، ومجاهدا.
I saw no one seek God’s countenance through this knowledge except ʿAṭāʾ, Ṭāwūs and Mujāhid.
I wish Nāfiʿ had a memory like yours.
كانوا يرون أنه يسأل أهل الكتاب.
They thought he consulted the People of the Book.
وكان فقيها عالما ثقة كثير الحديث.
He was a learned jurist, trustworthy and prolific in hadith.
